title: The Catalogue Is the Instrument: how the choice of sign inventory moves the statistics of an undeciphered script (code and results)
description: Scripts and results behind the paper draft: catalogue ladder (4.1x), catalogue-size sweep, composition tests (core-held, rule-free, scribal substitutions), syllabary references (Rapa Nui, Maori, Linear B) at matched size and length, transliteration-noise and Miller-Madow checks. Standard-library Python 3.10+; fetch_data.py downloads every input, nothing third-party is redistributed.
